meta.description: ACCEPTANCE, movement answer: bait the Iris Polyp's beam and dodge every volley (?polyp=1 solo stage). The early hops carry the bot over the chimney toward the span; from there movement is closed-loop: the funnel walks it into the locked post-mid lane only while the iris is quiet, commits any roof-tail crossing (never stalls in the band), and the moment the iris dilates (polypTell) while the bot stands in the lane it drops through the catwalk (down+jump, the game's own verb) below the band, re-mounting between volleys to re-bait. After 10.5s sim time it exits by vaulting the emplacement from the parked catwalk in a quiet window (a full jump from x<60 clears the bulb's contact circle) and runs out to the rejoin. Zero timed dodges: every polyp reaction keys off its telemetry state. EXPECTED (measured 5/5 across committed tuning runs): VICTORY, kills 0, every parked-cycle volley sweeping an EMPTY lane (bot on the deck below at fire time — the tell -> window -> answer loop). Honest variance: the first approach crossing and the release egress each sit on a dispatch-timing fork and may cost one contact/beam point (runs land at hp 3 or hp 1); a hit DURING a parked cycle, or kills>0, is the actual regression signal. KNOWN LIMIT (harness, not enemy): the open-loop approach hops fork on dispatch quantization and can jam a run in the chimney or dare pocket (~1 in 7 observed across all polyp scripts); the run then reports stalled/not-completed at x<57 with the polyp never engaged — re-run it.

jumpCounts.note: sliceStats.airJumps resets to 0 on every retry/resetGame — these reflect the current attempt only, not a session total

route.method: greedy nearest-connector-in-order match against a hardcoded fixture snapshot, radius 2.2 tiles — approximate, not a topological solve. routeIds (A.5 "route coverage") lists every route with >= 3 connectors matched in order; matchedRouteId/confidence is this harness's supplementary single-best-guess summary.

protoScore.note: proxy: airborneKills/links are approximated from kills+grounded and the route matcher, not real HB.score.events — see README
